campaign.title: K26 near-peak signed divisor-row Gram anti-concentration gate

resource_policy.computation_policy: No numerical theorem evidence is planned. Exact finite checks may only falsify cell normalizations or controls and cannot promote the asymptotic target.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact chi_4-weighted off-row divisor Gram form in every microscopic near-peak Fejer cell be bounded at local scale L X^epsilon, thereby proving the literal K26 endpoint, or does its first selector-stable contraction self-return or retain L^2 local capacity?
frozen_target.reference_formula: (1/2) sum_(epsilon=0)^1 2 Re sum_(d<d', d,d' odd) chi_4(d)chi_4(d') integral_(I_nu) R_(epsilon,d)(theta) conjugate(R_(epsilon,d')(theta)) dtheta <<_epsilon L X^epsilon uniformly for |nu|<=ceil(sqrt(L)).
quantities: J=sqrt(X), 1<<L<<H<=J^(1/2), R_0=ceil(L), and M asymp L^2 is the exact containing cardinality.
c_N^rem=sum_(d|N,d odd)chi_4(d)lambda_N(d), with every literal selector, squarefree, coprimality, two-adic, profile, endpoint, transition, and zero-extension field retained.
R_(epsilon,d)(theta)=sum_m(-1)^(epsilon m)lambda_(dm)(d)e(J sqrt(dm)+dm theta), and Z_epsilon=sum_d chi_4(d)R_(epsilon,d).
The in-round incidence gate is Lambda_2=sum_(d,m)|lambda_(dm)(d)|^2 << L^2 X^epsilon with O(L) cofactors per row.
The row diagonal and far spectral arcs are proposed target-safe; both implications must be independently rederived before promotion.
Local positive capacity is L^2 and endpoint positive capacity is L^4, while the targets are L and L^3 respectively.
The K17a high-q block and every other proof owner are forbidden pivots.

completion_criteria: Derive the exact physical divisor-row identity and sinc cell kernel, including wraparound and zero product difference.
Verify the literal incidence-energy and row-length bounds and prove the complete row diagonal is O(L X^epsilon) in each near cell.
Verify the Fejer near/far partition, Parseval normalization, ordinary-zero restoration, short correction, and implication from the local off-row theorem to Q_M^*<<L^3 X^epsilon.
Attack the complete literal off-row form before any positive norm, retaining every selector, phase, collision, endpoint, and both parity branches.
Prove the uniform near-cell target, prove a strict owner-complete target-safe sector with its exact complement, or establish the first exact capacity or self-return obstruction.
Run complex-dechirped, real-cosine, arbitrary-sign, constant-character, erased-selector, no-pair, one-row, one-site, exact-collision, product-collar, and hard-boundary controls.
Do not pivot to K17a, another M2 or M1 owner, GAR, assembly, a bridge, or an exponent.
Close under exactly one authorized exit label after blind and seam review.
